# WJ28 · Bạn bè · chưa có tài khoản cá nhân

Group **WJ · Quản trị agent (Next.js)** · state · Next.js: **exists (design W2)** (`/admin/friends`) · account `owner`

## Purpose
State of [WJ26](WJ26.md) · Bạn bè: chưa có tài khoản cá nhân. Page: Friend requests and friend list of a personal Zalo account: accept or decline pending requests and see who the account already talks to.

## Agent and care context
- Zalo does not return old requests: only those received since the feature was switched on and while the bot runs are shown. The pending requests poll every 7 seconds.

## Who may see it
- Account in this frame: `owner` (a mock account of `mock/auth.ts`; the back end decides the real matrix, the menu is a convenience).
- Gate: `admin.accounts`.
- Roles that can open the page: owner, manager.
- Menu entry: "Bạn bè" in the section "Quản trị agent", shown when the role holds any of `admin.accounts`.

## Key actions
- (actions of the page; this state or dialog adds the controls its Layout lists)
- Select a personal account
- "Chấp nhận" (acts at once) and "Từ chối" (confirm dialog) on a pending request
- "Làm mới" on the friend list

## Required text (keep verbatim)
- Chưa có tài khoản Zalo cá nhân nào.
- Chưa có tài khoản Zalo cá nhân nào. Tính năng bạn bè không áp dụng cho kênh bot.

## Business rules
- Patient safety is a policy profile, never a removed feature: `patient_channel` (the default: messages to patients go to the review queue and a person sends them; memory from patient content is off; image, video, document and web tools are off; a red flag goes to a doctor before any model call; personal data is masked before the model; identity of a Zalo user is confirmed before the assistant names a patient) and `staff_assistant` (internal, staff-only accounts). The profile is set per Zalo account and per agent, the stricter of the two applies (PLAN-AI01 section 5).
